user.title: Set up Vidos X
user.description: Add a Vidos X intercom / door station.

data_description.mode: Manual: you know the device IP. Cloud: sign in with your Vidos X account to discover devices.

data_description.device_ip: IP address of the intercom on your LAN.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable if the device uses a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device or cloud
error.no_devices: No devices found on this account

data.enable_lan_rung: Detect rings via LAN broadcast (fast, needs phone on Wi-Fi)

data_description.rtsp_url: e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.50:554/stream1 - enables the camera entity.
data_description.door_password: Unlock password for set.device.opendoor. Leave empty to use the device password (sent SHA-256 hashed).
data_description.enable_lan_rung: Listens for the Vidos app/door-station ASZENO discovery burst on UDP 5000/5001; fires the doorbell event within seconds of a ring. Turning it off falls back to status polling only.

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Open a door on a Vidos X device.
